items.summary: Google reports 88.2% on SEC-bench Pro (vulnerability finding) and 54.8% on ExploitGym, both state of the art, plus 71.0% on CWE-bench patching and a 0.0% Gray Swan prompt-injection success rate; introductory pricing is $2 in / $10 out per 1M tokens, doubling later. Access starts with a subset of cyber defenders and widens through the Fairwind Program, with US government pre-release testing. It lands a day after [[2026-10-27#0|OpenAI's GPT-6.1 Terra]] and pushes the offensive-security capability behind [[2026-10-22#4|PHP2Shell]] and [[2026-10-24#2|Anthropic's binary-level verification work]] into a shipped frontier model.
items.title: Google launches Gemini 4 Carbon, #1 on Artificial Analysis at 59, cyber-focused

items.summary: DeepMind calls it its first real-time world model to generate audio natively — music, ambient sound and interactive dialogue alongside the visuals — with physics such as aerodynamics and collisions, and Gemini steering the scene between user inputs to hold it together; long-horizon consistency and object permanence still drift. It is a research preview for trusted testers, coming to Google AI Ultra via Project Genie and to early partners in the Gemini API and AI Studio. It extends the interactive world-model line of [[2026-10-25#4|Kyutai's CADRE]] and [[2026-10-26#6|the video world-model survey]].
items.title: DeepMind's Genie 4 generates interactive worlds with native audio in real time

items.summary: Axiom says its agents produced a complete Lean formalization of the ~15,000-page classification theorem — built by over 100 mathematicians across generations — in 24 days, totalling about 43.1 million lines. Its CEO acknowledges no one outside the company has yet rebuilt the proof, so the artefact is unreplicated. It is the third AI-assisted mathematics claim in a week, after [[2026-10-28#0|OpenAI's three results]] and [[2026-10-22#0|Microsoft's KLS conjecture proof]], and the first where machine-checkability rather than a referee is the evidence.
items.title: Axiom auto-formalizes the Classification of Finite Simple Groups in Lean, 43.1M lines

items.summary: An 8B diffusion video world model taking free-form text instructions and continuous camera control across multiple interaction turns, pairing structured captions with action-aware causal attention so descriptive context persists across segments while action instructions bind only to their time window; weights, code and benchmarks are released. Tencent Hunyuan reports better human-evaluation scores than existing world models but publishes no numeric comparison. It is the open-weight counterpart to Genie 4 above, shipped the same day.
items.title: Tencent's Hy-Nomas: an 8B open-weight interactive world model with free-form control

items.summary: A Claude-proposed CAR T design about 70% shorter than standard produced roughly 10x the receptors with Generate Biomedicines; Divergence Labs generated ~35,000 antibody designs in a month, finding 3 that bind IgE and 20 that dislodge it; BigHat tested ~1,010 variants in 10 weeks for >10x tighter binding; Enveda cut review of 1,061 documentation pages from 25 hours to under three. Anthropic also acquired Mithril Medicine and says a derived muscular-dystrophy candidate could reach human trials as early as late 2028. All of it is self-reported and mostly preclinical. It follows [[2026-10-28#2|Insilico's TEAD inhibitor response rate]] and [[2026-10-22#7|the scorpion-neurotoxin binder campaign]].
items.title: Anthropic reports early preclinical results from six drug-development partnerships

items.summary: An NUS framework splits recursive self-improvement into a Creator that builds simplified simulated worlds per capability node, an Explorer that evolves reusable capability modules into a harness tree, and an Evolver that reorganizes tasks from surface categories into that tree, with a router selecting module configurations from public task information. Reported gains are +34 points mean across 28 training benchmarks and +26 across 18 unseen ones, including two real-world embodied tasks. It answers the instability [[2026-10-27#6|RSIHub found when rankings move across frameworks]] by making the harness itself the object of search.
items.title: The Trinity evolves agent harnesses along a capability tree, +26 points unseen

items.summary: LFM3-1.7B (text, 256K context), VL-2B (vision and video), Audio-2B (speech in/out, 18 languages), Omni-2B, and two d1 decision models; Liquid claims the 1.7B beats its own LFM2.5-2.6B with 35% fewer parameters and that VL-2B averages 71.4 across 62 vision benchmarks, level with Gemma 4 12B. Weights are on Hugging Face with AMD, Qualcomm, NVIDIA and Arm as launch partners; firms above $10M revenue need a commercial agreement. It extends the laptop-class open-weight push of [[2026-10-22#3|Recursive's Flint]] to every modality.
items.title: Liquid AI releases LFM3, six 2B-class open-weight multimodal models for devices

items.summary: A benchmark of 4.1K evaluation and 85K training samples separates explicit, implicit and dynamic intent; the StreamVibe-VL streaming model improves response timing and answer quality by 10.7% over baselines without losing general video understanding, and a harness storing intent as persistent state through hierarchical memory adds 12.3% on proactive interaction. It sharpens [[2026-10-24#8|StreamEval's finding that interactive streaming video models stay below 50]] by locating the failure in intent inference and when to speak.
items.title: StreamVibe benchmarks and trains video agents on implicit, shifting user intent

lead: Google released Gemini 4 Carbon, a cyber-focused frontier model it says ranks first on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at 59 and sets new state of the art on vulnerability finding and exploitation, available at first only to a subset of cyber defenders.
window: 28 Oct 07:00 → 29 Oct 07:00 JST (+ late catches from 26 Oct)
